correctness.rationale: The exact Johnson cut is reduced by paired identical columns to stacked unsigned Boolean up/down incidence operators. Over characteristic two they are exterior wedge by the all-ones vector and contraction by the all-ones covector. Their anticommutator is N mod 2; for even N the common kernel is u wedge exterior^(r-1) W of dimension binomial(N-2,r-1). The graph-state partial trace independently gives a flat normalized spectrum with 2^rank nonzero eigenvalues. Quantifiers and boundary k values are covered. Standalone exhaustive finite matrix checks corroborate 75 cases; seven exact density computations check the spectral conclusion. Finite checks are not claimed as an infinite proof.
